# Authored fixtures

These authored `OutputContent` fixtures use [schema 0.1](../output-document/README.md). Each includes a presentation document and separate host datasets. The shared [example catalog](../../examples/IntentBlazor.Examples/ExampleCatalog.cs) embeds them for the docs playground and tests.

| Fixture | Demonstrated data, state, and interactions |
| --- | --- |
| [news.json](news.json) | Synthetic headlines, selected article reference, conditional article card, source attribution, and rating. |
| [staff.json](staff.json) | Job table, typed sorting, selected job, owner lookup, notes draft, atomic selection effects, and draft clearing. |
| [assets.json](assets.json) | Asset list, selected preview and metadata, working label, and draft clearing. |

The crate and lantern SVGs in [the docs sample directory](../../apps/IntentBlazor.Docs/wwwroot/samples) are original IntentBlazor sample artwork distributed under the repository's [MIT license](../../LICENSE). No external game artwork is included.

Commands `news`, `staff`, and `assets` load known fixtures through `ExampleInputProcessor`. This is deterministic input processing, not an AI response. There is no live news, business mutation, image generation, asset modification, or persisted session. Invalid graphs, schemas, bindings, records, actions, JSON, stale events, and boundary cases are generated by the automated tests rather than shipped as misleading supported examples.
